title: Set response metadata
summary: Ruby on Rails: Set response metadata. Inspect the cache header.
introduction: response.headers holds reply headers. Open GET /note. Read the example, then check the result.
learningObjectives: Set response metadata with Ruby on Rails

blocks.text: Create a practice project with rails new school --api --skip-active-record. Enter it. Put each labelled section into its named file, then run bin/rails server -b 127.0.0.1 -p 8000. No database is needed.

blocks.title: Set response metadata
blocks.code:
# config/routes.rb
Rails.application.routes.draw do
get "/note", to: "lesson#note"
end

# app/controllers/lesson_controller.rb
class LessonController < ActionController::API
def note
 response.headers["Cache-Control"] = "no-store"
 render plain: "Practice note"
end
end

blocks.text: The response header is assigned before render sends the plain text.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Set headers before the response is completed.
